<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#1D1B20">9:41</text>
  <g fill="#1D1B20">
    <rect x="302" y="12" width="3" height="8" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="307" y="10" width="3" height="10" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="312" y="8" width="3" height="12" rx="1"/>
    <rect x="317" y="6" width="3" height="14" rx="1"/>
    <circle cx="331" cy="16" r="2.2"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="10" x2="347" y2="10" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="14" x2="352" y2="14" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="18" x2="344" y2="18" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="354" y="8" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="376" y="12" width="3" height="4" rx="1" fill="#1D1B20"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="52" width="390" height="68" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="68" width="40" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="80" x2="44" y2="96" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="80" x2="28" y2="96" stroke="#1D1B20" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="90" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">How do you want to pay?</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Subheading -->
  <text x="16" y="136" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Choose a payment method to fund your transfer.</text>

  <!-- Selected methods section header -->
  <text x="16" y="170" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Available methods</text>
  <text x="310" y="170" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Learn more</text>
  <line x1="16" y1="180" x2="374" y2="180" stroke="#0E0F0C1F" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Payment option cards -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="193" width="356" height="66" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="16" y="192" width="356" height="66" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="225" r="18" fill="#16330024"/>
    <text x="44" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">₱</text>
    <text x="76" y="214" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">PayNow</text>
    <text x="76" y="236" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Fastest way. Usually instant and free.</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="225" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="345,225 349,229 356,220" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="268" width="356" height="78" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="16" y="267" width="356" height="78" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="306" r="18" fill="#16330024"/>
    <rect x="36" y="298" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="37" y1="302" x2="51" y2="302" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="76" y="293" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Manual Bank Transfer</text>
    <text x="76" y="315" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Transfer from your bank using account details.</text>
    <text x="76" y="332" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Takes 1–2 business days · Reference required</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="306" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="356" width="356" height="78" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="16" y="355" width="356" height="78" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="394" r="18" fill="#16330024"/>
    <rect x="34" y="387" width="20" height="14" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="390" x2="50" y2="390" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="394" x2="50" y2="394" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="76" y="381" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Debit Card</text>
    <text x="76" y="403" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#454745">Pay instantly with a Visa or Mastercard.</text>
    <text x="76" y="420" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Apple Pay and Google Pay also supported</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="394" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="394" r="6.5" fill="#163300"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="16" y1="446" x2="374" y2="446" stroke="#0E0F0C1F" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Unavailable methods section -->
  <text x="16" y="475" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Unavailable methods</text>
  <text x="263" y="475" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Why aren’t these available?</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="490" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
    <rect x="16" y="489" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="521" r="18" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="44" y="526" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">⏱</text>
    <text x="76" y="516" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Bank transfer to Wise balance</text>
    <text x="76" y="537" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Temporarily unavailable for this route.</text>
    <rect x="312" y="506" width="46" height="24" rx="12" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="335" y="522" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Soon</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="562" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
    <rect x="16" y="561" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="593" r="18" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="44" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">◌</text>
    <text x="76" y="588" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Apple Pay</text>
    <text x="76" y="609" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Not supported for this recipient currency.</text>
    <rect x="304" y="578" width="54" height="24" rx="12" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="331" y="594" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Hidden</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="634" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
    <rect x="16" y="633" width="356" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="665" r="18" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="44" y="670" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">$</text>
    <text x="76" y="660" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Bank debit</text>
    <text x="76" y="681" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Available only for local USD transfers.</text>
    <rect x="304" y="650" width="54" height="24" rx="12" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="331" y="666" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#6A6C6A">Locked</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helper info card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="716" width="356" height="74" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#0E0F0C1F"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="753" r="16" fill="#9FE870"/>
    <text x="44" y="758" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#163300">i</text>
    <text x="72" y="742" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0E0F0C">Keep your transfer moving</text>
    <text x="72" y="762" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">You can switch payment methods before confirming.</text>
    <text x="72" y="780" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">View transfer steps</text>
  </g>

  <!-- CTA footer -->
  <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="796" x2="390" y2="796" stroke="#0E0F0C1F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="16" y="815" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Need help choosing? Fees and speed vary by method.</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="270" y="804" width="104" height="32" rx="16" fill="#16330014"/>
    <text x="322" y="825" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="796" x2="390" y2="796" stroke="#0E0F0C1F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g transform="translate(12,801)">
    <g transform="translate(0,0)">
      <rect x="10" y="5" width="14" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="17,1 6,9 28,9" fill="none" stroke="#163300" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="17" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#163300">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(78,0)">
      <rect x="8" y="4" width="18" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="9" x2="26" y2="9" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="17" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Card</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(156,0)">
      <circle cx="17" cy="14" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="6" x2="17" y2="22" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="9" y1="14" x2="25" y2="14" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="17" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Send</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(234,0)">
      <circle cx="14" cy="11" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <circle cx="24" cy="16" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="17" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Recipients</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(312,0)">
      <rect x="8" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="10" x2="26" y2="10" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <line x1="17" y1="5" x2="17" y2="19" stroke="#868685" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="17" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6A6C6A">Manage</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
